AI Summary
The Forward Deployed Engineer will be responsible for building and deploying enterprise applications and AI-powered solutions, combining full-stack engineering, Azure data engineering, and AI/ML development. Key duties include developing user interfaces with React and TypeScript/JavaScript, backend APIs with Python and C#/.NET, and integrating AI/ML, GenAI, and Agentic AI capabilities. The role requires expertise in Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Python/PySpark, and Microsoft Copilot Studio. Candidates must have experience with REST APIs, Azure App Service, Application Insights, and development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Visual Studio Code. The position involves end-to-end engineering from specification to deployment and ongoing support. Hands-on experience with enterprise AI/ML solutions and integrating AI agents is preferred.

India T&M Special Bonus:  

Req ID: 390571 

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer to join our team in Anywhere, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).

Forward Deployed Engineer – Full Stack, Azure, AI/ML & Agentic AI

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to build and deploy enterprise applications and AI-powered solutions based on approved business and technical specifications. The role combines full-stack engineering, Azure data engineering, enterprise integration, AI/ML, GenAI, and Agentic AI development.

Key Responsibilities

Execute specification-driven development based on approved business and technical specifications.
Develop user interfaces using React and TypeScript/JavaScript and backend/API services using Python and C#/.NET.
Build APIs, integrations, workflows, orchestration logic, prompts, agents, business rules, and AI-powered services.
Develop and integrate AI/ML, GenAI, and Agentic AI capabilities within enterprise applications and decision-support solutions.
Develop data ingestion pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF) and data transformation/processing solutions using Azure Databricks and Python/PySpark, supporting Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold).
Develop indexing, search, retrieval, RAG, embeddings, and grounding capabilities for enterprise AI applications.
Build and integrate AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Apps/Power Platform, enterprise APIs, workflows, and approved data sources.
Develop workflow, integration, and serverless components using Azure Logic Apps and Azure Functions/Function Apps.
Extend existing AI Assistant capabilities within GIP through secure integration of APIs, enterprise knowledge, data sources, tools, actions, and agent workflows.
Deploy and support applications using Azure App Service and implement monitoring, telemetry, and diagnostics using Azure Application Insights.
Develop and maintain source code, configuration artifacts, prompts, rules, automated/unit tests, validation scripts, and technical documentation.
Participate in code reviews, testing, defect remediation, CI/CD, deployment, environment configuration, quality assurance, and release management.
Use GitHub Copilot and VS Code for rapid prototyping and AI-assisted development while ensuring generated artifacts meet engineering, security, and quality standards.

Required Technical Skills

Programming: Python, C#/.NET
Frontend: React, TypeScript/JavaScript
AI/ML: Python-based AI/ML development, machine learning concepts, model development/integration, data preparation, evaluation and AI-powered solution development
GenAI & Agentic AI: LLMs, prompt engineering, AI agents, tool/action integration, RAG, embeddings, indexing, retrieval and grounding
Data Engineering: Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Databricks, Python/PySpark, Medallion Architecture
Microsoft AI & Power Platform: Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Apps/Power Platform
APIs & Integration: REST APIs, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions/Function Apps
Azure: Azure App Service, Application Insights and associated Azure services
DevOps & Quality: Git, CI/CD, unit/automated testing, code reviews, debugging and release management
Development Tools: GitHub Copilot, Visual Studio Code

Preferred Experience

Hands-on experience building enterprise AI/ML, GenAI and Agentic AI solutions, integrating AI agents with enterprise applications and data sources, developing production-grade RAG/retrieval solutions, implementing data pipelines and delivering full-stack applications on Azure.

Expected Engineering Lifecycle:
Specification → UI/API → Data & Integration → AI/ML & Agents → Testing → Deployment → Monitoring & Support
